learning.actionFailed: The action failed. Refresh status before trying again.
learning.ambiguous: The action outcome is unknown. Retry the same action to recover its authoritative result.
learning.completedRefreshFailed: The action completed, but status refresh failed. Refresh status before another action.
learning.conflict: Status changed or the action conflicted. Review refreshed status before choosing another action.
learning.description: Inspect account status and separate descriptor evidence, or explicitly restrict an account with safety controls. Mode alone does not establish an enabled private policy or successful learning.
learning.loadError: Learning status could not be loaded.
learning.noEvidence: Scoped evidence is unavailable; history and eligibility are unknown.
learning.operationIncomplete: The operation has not completed. Refresh status or retry the same action to inspect its result.
learning.readOnly: Learning status is read-only for your role.
learning.receivingExplanation: Receiving shared strategies does not grant contribution consent. These preferences are read-only here.
learning.safetyExplanation: Pause, shadow and disable send an explicit safety action for this account at its displayed revision. Queued-generation pause fencing is not established by this view.
learning.scopeUnavailable: Select a resolved organization and matching brand to view learning status.
learning.selectionExplanation: This selected strategy does not establish that it was applied to generation.
learning.threshold: The 20-sample threshold is informational. Meeting it alone does not mean trained, eligible or applied.
learning.title: Learning
learning.unauthorized: You are not authorized to perform this action.
